column3: In this Act, unless the context otherwise requires,-
“contempt  of  court”  means  civil  contempt  or
“civil contempt” means willful disobedience to any
judgment,  decree,  direction,  order,  writ  or  other
process of a court or willful breach of an undertaking
(whether by words, spoken or written or by signs or
by  visible  representations,  or  otherwise)  of  any
matter  or  the  doing  of  any  other  act  whatsoever
